title: Dataset of Electroencephalograms of Juvenile Offenders
description: Resting-state EEG recordings from 140 Colombian young people: 74 juvenile offenders and 66 non-offender controls. Data were acquired with a 128-channel Biosemi ActiveTwo system. The dataset provides epoched and preprocessed EEG, along with spectral band-power features (delta, theta, alpha, beta) for eyes-open and eyes-closed epochs. It is intended to support the study of neurocognition in juvenile delinquency.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded with a 128-channel Biosemi ActiveTwo system at 2048 Hz, with additional EOG and ECG channels. The paradigm alternated eyes closed and open. Preprocessing in EEGLAB/MATLAB included downsampling to 128 Hz, average re-referencing, 1-40 Hz FIR bandpass filtering, bad channel rejection, ASR, and ICA with ICLabel. Features were computed from Welch PSD in four frequency bands.
